body.definition: CHECK (((active = (retired_revision IS NULL)) AND ((retired_revision IS NULL) OR (retired_revision > activated_revision))))
CHECK ((octet_length((to_jsonb(ROW(wait_id, ordinal, waiter_key, blocker_key, active, activated_revision, retired_revision)))::text) <= 1024))
FOREIGN KEY (wait_id, ordinal) REFERENCES wait_owner_members(wait_id, ordinal)
CHECK ((octet_length((to_jsonb(ROW(wait_id, ordinal, member_id, owner, condition_digest, subscription_digest, blocker_kind, blocker_id, local_original, local_current)))::text) <= 2048))

CHECK ((octet_length((to_jsonb(ROW(wait_id, operation_id, request_digest, workspace_id, project_id, task_id, lineage_id, node_id, attempt_id, binding_digest, source_access_digest, policy_digest, source_profile, wait_generation, continuation_id, continuation_generation, outcome_id, resume_intent_id, member_count, envelope_bytes, created_at_ms, deadline_ms, revision, bridge_created_revision, bridge_retired_revision, logical_now_ms, next_due_ms, phase, dirty_generation, work_generation, retired, cancel_operation_id, terminal_digest, resume_state)))::text) <= 8192))

CHECK ((((phase = 'terminal'::text) = (bridge_retired_revision IS NOT NULL)) AND ((bridge_retired_revision IS NULL) OR (bridge_retired_revision > bridge_created_revision)) AND ((phase = 'terminal'::text) = (terminal_digest IS NOT NULL)) AND (retired = (cancel_operation_id IS NOT NULL)) AND ((NOT retired) OR ((resume_state = 'retired'::text) AND (phase = 'terminal'::text))) AND ((cancel_operation_id IS NULL) OR (cancel_operation_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid))))
FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, project_id, task_id) REFERENCES wait_owner_tasks(workspace_id, project_id, task_id)

CHECK ((plaintext_bytes <=
CASE kind
    WHEN 'original'::text THEN 131072
    WHEN 'snapshot'::text THEN 262144
    WHEN 'work'::text THEN 262144
    WHEN 'registration'::text THEN 16384
    WHEN 'cancellation'::text THEN 16384
    WHEN 'outcome'::text THEN 131072
    WHEN 'resume'::text THEN 8192
    WHEN 'completion'::text THEN 16384
    ELSE NULL::integer
END))
CHECK (((octet_length((to_jsonb(ROW(wait_id, kind, revision, plaintext_bytes, plaintext_digest, sealed_version, key_id, nonce, ciphertext_digest)))::text) + 16) <= 1024))

CHECK (COALESCE((((plaintext_bytes = 0) AND (revision = 0) AND (plaintext_digest IS NULL) AND (sealed_version IS NULL) AND (key_id IS NULL) AND (nonce IS NULL) AND (ciphertext IS NULL) AND (ciphertext_digest IS NULL)) OR ((plaintext_bytes > 0) AND (revision > 0) AND (plaintext_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND (sealed_version = 1) AND (key_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$'::text) AND (octet_length(nonce) = 12) AND (octet_length(ciphertext) = (plaintext_bytes + 16)) AND (ciphertext_digest = encode(sha256(ciphertext), 'hex'::text)))), false))
FOREIGN KEY (active_wait_id) REFERENCES wait_owner_records(wait_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
CHECK ((octet_length((to_jsonb(ROW(workspace_id, project_id, task_id, lineage_id, generation, active_wait_id)))::text) <= 8192))
FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, project_id) REFERENCES wait_owner_projects(workspace_id, project_id)
CHECK ((((state = 'leased'::text) = (lease_id IS NOT NULL)) AND ((lease_id IS NULL) = (lease_expires_ms IS NULL))))
CHECK (((lease_expires_ms IS NULL) OR ((lease_expires_ms > transition_at_ms) AND (lease_expires_ms <= '9007199254740991'::bigint))))
CHECK ((octet_length((to_jsonb(ROW(wait_id, generation, state, next_due_ms, lease_id, lease_expires_ms, transition_at_ms)))::text) <= 8192))
